tasks.title: Choose architecture and establish the build system
tasks.goal: Decide a free-first technical direction and establish resumable bounded work.
acceptance: Compare current RPGJS/Phaser source and docs; distinguish source review from runtime validation.
Record delegated decisions, free-asset policy, first-session loop and persistent/resettable state.
Provide a validated dependency roadmap, generated continuation prompt and dated handoff.
exclusions: No sequel runtime, asset import, account mutation or cloud provisioning.

tasks.title: Separate local repository and engine pilot
tasks.goal: Prove the selected browser engine can move, interact and transition on desktop and phone layouts.
acceptance: Inspect current worktrees/PRs and search for an existing sequel repository; create a separate local repository only if absent. Carry planning documents, tracker, local instructions and notices into it, fix their relative links, and leave exact source/authority pointer in 1.0.

Use exact-pinned Phaser 4.2.1 initially, compatible TypeScript/Vite versions and a lockfile; inspect release/dependency metadata and scripts before installation, avoid telemetry and unlicensed demo art. Record justified version changes.
One original placeholder outdoor scene plus workshop transition; keyboard and tap movement, collision, interact/cancel, DOM destination list; menus block world input.
Automated build/type checks and Playwright walk/interact/transition/reload at 1440x900, 390x844, 360x640 and 844x390; capture screenshots and console/page/network errors with all data synthetic.
Record compressed initial transfer, frame sampling methodology, input/UI bounds and capability limits; no benchmark or real-phone claim without evidence. Reopen engine decision if budgets fail.
exclusions: No production login, live backend, cloud resources, finished asset library or new features.

tasks.title: Natural continuous movement and living-town design capture
tasks.goal: Address direct pilot feedback about grid-like motion and preserve the expanded living-town direction.
acceptance: Continuous keyboard motion with normalized diagonals, immediate steering/release and precise pointer endpoints; no snapping on menu lock, stopping or local save/reload.
Retain obstacle collision, sliding, obstacle-aware destination paths, scene transitions and input locks at desktop, phone and short viewports; meaningful domain and actual-input browser checks.
Record quests/skills/gathering/restoration/NPC/rare-decor direction and staged boundaries; distinguish proposed systems from implemented preview features.
Update screenshots/evidence, state, history and handoff; preserve local-only source and unchanged 1.0 game.
exclusions: No quests/economy/backend implementation, paid assets, cloud/remote provisioning or 1.0 changes.

tasks.title: Click doors to approach and enter
tasks.goal: Direct door clicks/taps approach and activate a transition automatically once in range.
acceptance: Click the workshop door from outside interaction range; actor walks around obstacles and enters automatically, with no HUD Enter click. Apply the same interaction to the exit door.
Keep keyboard/HUD/destination navigation alternatives; entry is one-shot, only from explicit door intent and cancelled by steering, another target, menu/stop or room change.
Run domain tests and actual pointer/touch browser walkthroughs on desktop/phone/narrow/short; preserve movement, collision, save/reload and input locks.
Document user acceptance of natural movement and future animation/art polish, update source handoff/evidence, keep local-only/no 1.0 changes.
exclusions: No graphics redesign, backend, accounts, economy, remote/cloud resources or current-game change.

tasks.title: Return outside the building door on exit
tasks.goal: Use authored safe arrival positions rather than a shared square spawn.
acceptance: All exit controls place the player directly outside the workshop door and persist that position.
Collision-safe transition metadata is verified; standing at the returned doorway does not auto-enter.
Domain/browser checks and desktop/phone exit evidence; preserve existing movement and local-only game state.
exclusions: No new game systems, 1.0 change or hosting.

tasks.title: Private GitHub source and sequel CI checkpoint
tasks.goal: Make the local sequel source durable and resumable through GitHub before substantial art/content work.
acceptance: Check for an existing dadbod87 sequel repository; choose private visibility by default, never overwrite an existing remote or publish publicly. Confirm no new paid feature or hosting resource is required.

Establish separate build, domain, browser and planning/integrity checks on GitHub using pinned versions, isolated synthetic data and collected screenshot artifacts. Resolve actual permission limits transparently; do not bypass restrictions or claim a workflow ran if it did not.
Push the exact local pilot/history to the verified private source, run required checks on the final commit and record remote URL, branch, commit and next task in both source and bridge pointers.
exclusions: No game hosting, real accounts, live backend, public repository or paid service.

tasks.title: Choose and prove one coherent visual kit
tasks.goal: Make the same representative scene readable, warm and distinct on a phone.
acceptance: Compare an original illustrated sample and a coherent verified CC0 pixel sample for the same workshop/square/player scene; choose and record one without requiring routine approval.
Asset manifest includes source/archive hash, exact files/licenses, creator/credits and modifications; no paid or unknown assets.
Produce representative player/prop/building/UI scale sheet and desktop/narrow/short screenshots; check silhouettes, contrast, 200% text zoom, reduced motion and 44px touch targets.
Lock camera/tile/animation/material conventions; identify missing art before bulk production.
Include one before/after restoration sample and a clear quest/interaction affordance; do not expand into a full second district.
exclusions: No bulk city art, paid pack, account data or production release.

tasks.title: Playable local workshop loop
tasks.goal: Make the first five minutes enjoyable with isolated deterministic state.
acceptance: Pure domain modules support gathering, two recipes, legal personal placement and one timed bench job; Phaser remains disposable view state.
Versioned synthetic local save survives reload; deterministic clock tests cover completion, offline cap, storage limit and no duplicated settlement. Mark local saves as non-authoritative prototype.
Show exact resource changes, clear feedback, free preview/cancel and useful first-minute completion; test keyboard/touch workflow with no shifting controls.
Capture a short playtest report against first-session brief; record confusing/boring steps and resolve blockers before shared play.

Add deterministic progression-cohort simulation for slow days/weeks pacing; compare idle, regular and active schedules and housing/project milestones before final economy tuning. First fast craft is a one-time tutorial, not repeatable click income.
Integrate a short personal quest chain and small gathering/making skill progression into the existing loop; simulate bounded unlocks and useful crafting choices before broad recipe trees.
exclusions: No public economy, trading, exponential progression, purchases, auth or claim that local saves are secure.

tasks.title: Durable shared bridge and two-player proof
tasks.goal: Move rules to a local authoritative server and make two synthetic players cooperate safely.
acceptance: Implement an isolated authoritative command service and disposable PostgreSQL with migrations, separate synthetic identities and scoped authorization; evaluate Supabase-compatible functions/auth boundaries before choosing deployment runtime; no 1.0 secrets/data.

Validate scoped room/presence updates; use Colyseus only if needed after comparing suitable Supabase realtime and command boundaries. Durable resources, jobs, house plots and projects remain atomic PostgreSQL transactions.

Test duplicate command IDs, concurrent last contributions, insufficient inventory, unauthorized edits, disconnect/reconnect, server restart, stale client and migration/restore; no double charge or lost committed progress.

Server validates gathering/proximity/rates; receipt replay is deterministic; visible loading/error/retry never invents a reward. Room updates scoped, bounded movement sends, no animation database writes.
Verify simulated weekly rollover changes only season-keyed scores and preserves inventory, jobs, decoration and bridge. Capture two-client desktop/phone evidence.
Prove plot acquisition/owner-only edits and upgrade/placement persistence, including concurrent claims, visitor denial and newcomers joining after initial plot allocations.

Personal/shared quest progress and associated rewards derive from validated actions, stable IDs and atomic receipts; test duplicate/replay/concurrent completion and quest-content version migration without real data.
exclusions: No real accounts, hosted database, paid transport service, production load test or huge multiplayer world.

tasks.title: Polished first neighborhood
tasks.goal: Deliver the small persistent neighborhood with coherent art, story and useful phone navigation.
acceptance: Workshop/square/cafe/trail, three resources/two recipes/one project and six props meet the brief; locked art kit and provenance cover shipped content.
Inventory, dialogue, crafting, decorating, destination directory and offline summary work on narrow phones/short landscape and keyboard; no obstructed essentials.
Fresh/resumed/reconnected two-client playthroughs, weekly rollover and regression suites pass; inspect screenshots and small UX findings list.
Measure play duration and identify a reason to return without mandatory waiting or punitive reset. Fix first-session blockers.

Include expandable personal plots, starter house and one home upgrade/decorating path; validate slow progression targets using isolated accelerated-time fixtures, with humor and useful newcomer teamwork.

Bridge/trail restoration visibly changes the place and authored NPC reactions; include a modest cosmetic discovery path without luck-gating required access. Larger helpers/shops/areas remain post-beta extensions.
exclusions: No broad expansion, marketplace, PvP, guild politics, public chat or monetization.

tasks.title: Cost, performance and isolated release readiness
tasks.goal: Prepare a concrete affordable private-preview package and prove recovery before inviting anyone.
acceptance: Run bounded 20-client synthetic tests only on local/authorized isolated environment; report commands/events/queries, latency percentiles, frame time, CPU/memory, storage and bandwidth against budgets.

Prefer GitHub CI/source, Vercel client delivery and separate Supabase database/auth/storage where appropriate. Measure whether extra persistent-room hosting is needed; present modest cost/limits/backup plan before provisioning any billed service. No asset purchases.
Threat/permission review, auth plan, rate limits, data retention, migration/backup/restore drill and rollback plan complete; real phone manual check pending clearly if unavailable.

Create a reviewable private-preview deployment/access plan with exact artifact, targets, costs, separate identity/data, monitoring and support. Resolve any required access/budget decision before dependent work.
exclusions: No unapproved cloud billing, real-player writes, public release or 1.0 account import.

tasks.title: Invited beta on approved isolated hosting
tasks.goal: Run a small separate private beta after hosting/access gates are resolved.
acceptance: Approved preview target and cost boundary recorded before provisioning; deploy exact tested artifact with isolated database/auth and verified backup/restore.
Verify deployed SHA/artifact and real flows using dedicated test accounts with explicit fixture disclosure; desktop and real-phone screenshots.
Invite-only access, credits, beta notice, understandable persistence/offline rules and feedback route; no silent import of existing accounts.
Observe representative concurrent play within approved bounds; triage blockers, record known issues and rollback/recovery evidence.
exclusions: No public launch, new paid plan, current-game migration or unbounded load test.

tasks.title: Public-launch decision and release
tasks.goal: Prepare a safe, reviewable launch and release only with explicit public-launch authorization.
acceptance: Beta blockers resolved with reproducible evidence, permission/device/performance/cost checks current, onboarding and persistent/reset wording correct.
Prepare final artifact/commit, release notes, hosting quotas, rollback, backup and support plan for Nick. Explicit public launch/domain authorization recorded before publication.
After authorization, deploy/verify actual production artifact and live desktop/phone flows; disclose test data and limitations, then close out exact release and follow-up backlog.
exclusions: No assumed public launch from planning approval; no asset purchases or monetization added.
